reason: The paddlecv subdirectory documents CPU-runnable inference (tools/predict.py) with small pretrained inference models auto-downloaded and no credentials.
demo: paddlecv/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md 部署示例 image classification (PP-LCNet) + docs/INSTALL.md 快速体验 object detection (PP-YOLOE+)
goal: In /work/models/paddlecv (see docs/INSTALL.md and docs/GETTING_STARTED.md), install PaddlePaddle (CPU) and the dependencies paddlecv needs, then on CPU run `python -u tools/predict.py --config=configs/single_op/PP-LCNet.yml --input=demo/ILSVRC2012_val_00020010.jpeg --output_dir=<dir>` and the install guide's detection check `python -u tools/predict.py --config=configs/single_op/PP-YOLOE+.yml --input=demo/000000014439.jpg --output_dir=<dir>`. The pretrained inference models download automatically; each command must write its structured result and visualised image to the output directory. Write /work/env.sh that activates whatever environment is needed so `python` runs them.
check: The hidden test runs both commands on the bundled demo images and checks the classification result names the dog breed shown with ranked top-5 scores, and the detection result contains the people visible in the demo image with valid boxes and scores, plus the saved output images.

revision.by: second review (outside the maintained set; independent log check of maintained passes)
issues: Too lenient: the classification check accepts any 5 ranked labels; it never checks that the bundled demo image (a Weimaraner, ImageNet class 178) is recognised, so wrong preprocessing, a wrong label map or garbage weights would pass. The real run produced Weimaraner 0.884 at rank 1.

Coverage: paddlecv's own install guide ends with an object-detection quick check (PP-YOLOE+ on demo/000000014439.jpg, reference output image bundled); only the single classification op is tested. v2 adds that documented detection command and checks for the many 'person' boxes the reference output shows.
Choosing paddlecv as the demo is right: the repo root README is a catalogue with no runnable example.
evidence: paddlecv/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md:40-53 — deployment examples (classification, detection, segmentation, OCR) via tools/predict.py
paddlecv/docs/INSTALL.md:74-88 — '快速体验' runs PP-YOLOE+ on demo/000000014439.jpg; reference demo/000000014439_output.jpg shows ~12 person boxes
paddlecv/configs/single_op/PP-YOLOE+.yml — ParserDetResults threshold 0.5, DetOutput inputs dt_bboxes/dt_scores/dt_cls_names, save_res True
paddlecv/ppcv/ops/output/detection.py:114 writes det_output.json; classification.py:52 writes clas_output.json
README.md (repo root) — catalogue of official/research/community model lists, no runnable command
